content.text:
The grey text on the home page is now `#3d4650`. The functional tests pass (16 of 16), but I haven't looked at the page in a browser.

I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css` that sets `--color-muted` to `#3d4650` inside `.page-home main`. Only the home page uses that class, so the other pages are unchanged.

It darkens all the grey text in the main content of the home page:
- the hero paragraph
- the stat labels
- the card descriptions
- the newsletter note

I left the footer text at the old grey, since it isn't under a heading. If you want it darker too, move the rule from `.page-home main` to `.page-home`.

STATUS: DONE
